description: Export as CSV text for analysis: messages, deliveries, events, opt_outs, webhook_deliveries, usage, usage_monthly, audit_log or credit_history. At most 50,000 rows; narrow the date range with from and to.

action.description: audit_log: one action, or a group prefix with a trailing dot (team.)

actor.description: audit_log: actor id or part of the actor email

blocked_reason.description: messages, deliveries: blocked messages with this reason

created_after.description: audit_log: same as on GET /audit-logs (from is accepted too)

created_before.description: audit_log: same as on GET /audit-logs (to is accepted too)

failure_code.description: messages, deliveries: failed for this reason (the `failure.code` on a message)

from.description: ISO date/time or epoch ms (messages, deliveries, events, webhook_deliveries)

kind.description: messages, deliveries, events, opt_outs, webhook_deliveries, usage, usage_monthly, audit_log or credit_history

months.description: usage: daily rows for the last N months

number.description: messages, deliveries: digits matched against either side

q.description: messages: body/failure text; events: id/payload text

to.description: Inclusive; a bare date means the end of that day (UTC)

to_number.description: messages, deliveries: exact recipient (E.164). `to`/`from` are the date range here.

name: export_csv
title: Export csv
